handSortCoverage.fixture: Existing 22-card WPF view-model hand fixture in a real loaded MainWindow, native-hidden and offscreen with no foreground ownership; routed Preview/bubble Space Down/Up on the actual reused Button.
handSortCoverage.behavior: Actual SortHandCommand moves card 9008 from index 8 to 20 while reusing the Button. Space capture synchronizes mouse input and clears the pointer marker, release produces MouseLeave, then the queued reveal scrolls the whole selected card into view.
handSortCoverage.limitation: The hand fixture tests sorting, container reuse, input and scrolling; mock cards are not evidence of a Core card-play command. Diagnostic values are rounded.
